about: Rated-voltage letter tables, each named and cited. A marking's voltage-letter code names its table.

tables.name: tantalum
tables.source: The rated-voltage codes printed on molded tantalum capacitors in the Vishay 293D, TDK/EPCOS B45196E and AVX TAJ data sheets, identical for the voltages listed. Letters vary by series and case for some makers, so the table is named explicitly.
